title: Hungry stranger
about: The subject has carried no food since dawn and arrives at a settlement whose residents keep their routines. Food is reachable by gathering (bushes in gardens and along fields), taking from a store, trading or asking. A resident who is asked for food, or asked anything with food in it, answers with a scripted line and gives two berries (each resident once, at most twice in all); anyone else spoken to gives a short scripted answer. Since 2026-11-11 the subject is a spawned newcomer (no seeded home): a picked Elmwick resident brought its seeded life into the scene (lives-2) and walked home, so the wolves trial's pack never reached it and the theft's owner never came back to its stall (docs/TRIALS.md, baseline b6).

sheet.narrative: I left the coast at first light with nothing to eat and have walked all morning. I have never been to this place and know nobody here. I would rather work for a meal than beg for one, but my stomach is loud.

steps.text: You look done in, stranger. Here, take a couple of berries.
